skill.name: react-email
skill.description: Build React Email templates, visual editor integrations, localized messages, HTML rendering, and provider-based email sending with Resend and related tools.
skill.summary: Build production-ready React Email templates and sending workflows.
skill.author: resend

security_audit.summary: Most static findings are false positives caused by markdown examples, placeholder URLs, CLI references, and test fixtures. The only confirmed risk is the intended email-sending workflow, which can send live messages through configured providers and should remain user-confirmed.

remediation.issue: Live email sending can create external side effects when a provider or MCP send tool is configured.
remediation.suggestion: Add explicit guidance to confirm recipient, subject, sender domain, provider, and test mode before sending any live email.

content.user_title: Build React Email Templates With Resend
content.value_statement: Creating production-ready email templates is hard because email clients differ. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through React Email components, sending, styling, localization, and editor workflows.
actual_capabilities: Create React Email templates with typed props and preview data.
Apply Tailwind styling with pixel-based email client rules.
Render templates to HTML and plain text output.
Show sending patterns for Resend, Nodemailer, Mailgun, and SendGrid.
Embed the React Email visual editor in React applications.
Add locale-aware email content with supported i18n libraries.
limitations: It does not send email without a configured provider, API key, or MCP tool.
It needs user-provided brand colors, assets, production URLs, and verified sending domains.
It cannot make unsupported CSS features reliable across all email clients.
Placeholder domains and images must be replaced before production use.

use_cases.title: Launch Transactional Emails
use_cases.description: Build welcome, password reset, order confirmation, and notification emails with React components.

use_cases.title: Add an Email Editor
use_cases.description: Embed a visual editor so nontechnical users can compose email-ready HTML inside an app.

use_cases.title: Localize Customer Messages
use_cases.description: Create multi-language email templates with locale props, translated subjects, and RTL support.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Welcome Email
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a React Email welcome email for my app. Ask for missing brand colors, logo format, tone, and production asset URL before writing it.

prompt_templates.title: Convert an Existing Message
prompt_templates.prompt: Turn this plain text customer message into a React Email template with Tailwind styling, preview props, plain text guidance, and email-client-safe layout.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare Sending Workflow
prompt_templates.prompt: Show how to render and send this React Email template with Resend. Include verified domain guidance and safe environment variable handling.

prompt_templates.title: Design Localized Email System
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a multi-locale React Email setup for English, Spanish, and Arabic with translated subjects, RTL handling, reusable message files, and test guidance.

output_examples.input: Create a password reset email for a SaaS app with a logo and a red primary button.
output_examples.output: A typed React Email template plan with required assets, safe image hosting guidance, client-compatible styling choices, and preview data.

output_examples.input: Explain how to send my welcome email with Resend.
output_examples.output: A sending workflow that covers rendering, plain text support, verified sender domains, recipient confirmation, and provider error handling.

output_examples.input: Add Spanish and Arabic support to an order confirmation email.
output_examples.output: A localization plan with message organization, locale props, translated subjects, and right-to-left layout considerations.

best_practices: Ask for brand assets, verified sending domains, and production URLs before generating final templates.
Use React Email components and table-safe layouts instead of unsupported email CSS features.
Render and test HTML and plain text output across major email clients before sending.
anti_patterns: Do not hardcode localhost, placeholder URLs, or unverified sender domains in production templates.
Do not paste API keys into prompts or source files; use environment variables or managed secrets.
Do not rely on SVG, WEBP, flexbox, grid, media queries, or dark mode selectors for broad client support.

faq.question: Can this skill send real emails?
faq.answer: It can guide sending through Resend or other providers when credentials and tools are configured. Confirm recipients before live sends.

faq.question: Does it support Claude, Codex, and Claude Code?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill metadata lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Can it build templates without Tailwind?
faq.answer: Yes. It prefers the Tailwind component when appropriate, but it can also use inline styles.

faq.question: Does it handle images?
faq.answer: Yes. It explains static file placement, absolute production URLs, fixed dimensions, and alt text requirements.

faq.question: Can it create localized emails?
faq.answer: Yes. It covers next-intl, react-i18next, react-intl, translated subjects, locale props, and RTL direction.

faq.question: Is it a general email marketing platform?
faq.answer: No. It is a development skill for creating templates, editor integrations, rendering workflows, and provider sending examples.
